date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r read in data}
data <- read.csv(here("data.csv")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(mpa_effect = if_yes_in_what_way_mpa_effect)
```

```{r mpa effect table}
effect_counts <- data %>% 
  count(mpa_effect)
 
temp <- effect_counts[-c(1), ]

#pie(temp)

ggplot(data = temp, aes(x = mpa_effect, y = n)) +
  geom_col()
```

```{r geography}
location_counts <- data %>% 
  count(marine_ecoregion)

temp2 <- location_counts[-c(1), ]

ggplot(data = temp2, aes(x = marine_ecoregion, y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))
```
